subject: history
concept: Understanding the difference between a neighborhood, a city/town, and a country as different-sized places
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student nests physical rings/hoops labeled neighborhood, city, country to show scale relationships
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described place to its correct size category
exercise.abstract: Student explains how their own neighborhood fits inside their city/town and country

misconception_flags: treats neighborhood, city, and country as separate/unrelated rather than nested

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
